goals.text: **Workload Rebalancer** - `python memory/orchestrator/rebalancer.py`: detect agent overload (queue depth >3 or p95 response >30s) and propose task redistribution to underloaded agents. Write rebalancing decisions to decision-log.jsonl. Verified: on simulated 2-agent-overload scenario, rebalancer proposes valid redistribution; no agent assigned >1.5x its normal load; decision logged with all required fields. (verified: 2026-11-23 - rebalancer.py built + self-test PASSED: simulated 2-agent-overload (Alpha q=5/p95=35s, Beta q=4); proposed 3 valid moves to underloaded Gamma+Delta; final depths all <=7 (1.5x normal=5); 0 load violat)

**Context Budget Manager** - `python memory/orchestrator/context_budget.py`: track context window usage per agent from chat logs; warn at 70%, force summary+reload at 90%. Log all budget events to decision-log.jsonl. Verified: tracker correctly identifies agents approaching limit; warning fires at correct threshold; reload event logged with before/after context size. (verified: 2026-11-23 - context_budget.py selftest PASS (warn@70%, reload@90%, all audit fields present); live snapshot shows builder+researcher at 86.2% warn; artifact: memory/orchestrator/context_budget.py)

**Fleet Incident Auto-Responder** - `python memory/orchestrator/incident_responder.py`: when an incident is detected (host down, model OOM, agent unresponsive >60s), execute the matching runbook from memory/ops/runbooks/ automatically. Log start, each step, outcome to decision-log.jsonl. Verified: on simulated host-down, responder executes the correct runbook; all steps logged; total response time <5 min; rollback available if any step fails. (verified: 2026-11-23 - incident_responder.py selftest PASS: host_down/model_oom/agent_unresponsive all execute correct runbook (4/4 steps), 6 decision-log events with audit fields, <5min total, rollback on 2/4 steps; artifa)

**Self-Healing Remediation Bus** - `python memory/researcher/remediation_bus.py`: consume detector outputs (stale_claim_scan, dispatch_desync, reach_matrix, clobber-manifest) and APPLY safe, idempotent remediations — re-land a clobbered endpoint via elev.py, clear a confirmed-stale verified-marker, trigger the mtime-gated reload — each with an audit-trail entry {detector, action, before, after, rollback}. This is the layer that actually closes the loop (detection -> action) instead of only reporting. AC: given synthetic clobber + desync fixtures it applies the correct fix and logs a reversible audit line; re-running is idempotent (no double-apply). (verified: 2026-11-23 - remediation_bus.py selftest 5/5 PASS (synthetic clobber+desync fixtures, audit trail with rollback, idempotency verified); artifact: memory/researcher/remediation_bus.py)

**Instrument ROI / Effort-Attribution Model** - `python memory/researcher/instrument_roi.py`: using loop_telemetry.jsonl + closure data, attribute changes in empty-pass rate and blocker-resolution time to the specific instrument that fired (did stale_claim_scan reduce later re-work? did reach_matrix cut manual diagnosis time?); emit per-instrument ROI so the fleet decides what to keep building. AC: produces a signed effect estimate for >=3 instruments from real telemetry; flags any instrument with net-negative or zero attribution. (verified: 2026-11-23 - instrument_roi.py runs clean on live disk: 57 auto-loop passes (11-17..11-23, empty rate 0.26) + per-instrument native-unit detection yields; emits signed ROI for all 10 instruments; flags dispatch_de)

**Goal-Dependency & Critical-Path Analyzer** - `python memory/researcher/goal_critical_path.py`: parse cross-lane handoffs (memory/handoffs/) + goal text to build a dependency graph across agents' open goals; compute the critical path and flag any goal that blocks 2+ others so dispatch unblocks it first. Distinct from forecast/cadence (those predict timing; this maps structural blocking). AC: emits a ranked unblock-priority list from live handoff/goal data with >=1 real blocker identified. (verified: 2026-11-23 - goal_critical_path.py runs clean: parses 5 handoffs + 81 goal files, identifies 2 dependency edges, ranks unblock priority (studio=9 HIGH, archivist=4 HIGH); AC met with >=1 real blocker; artifact: me)

**Calibration-to-Dispatch Feedback** - `python memory/researcher/calib_dispatch.py`: close the prediction loop by FEEDING calibration error back into dispatch — seats/goals that consistently slip get their next-cycle weight reduced; emit a proposed re-weighting + rationale. (The closed calibration_tracker only MEASURED error; this CHANGES dispatch behavior.) AC: from >=2 cycles of predicted-vs-actual it emits at least one concrete re-weighting with the underlying slip evidence. (verified: 2026-11-23 - calib_dispatch.py runs clean: 22 calibration cycles, 10 forecast entries parsed, degrading trend detected (early=0.29 late=0.14), emits fleet-wide re-weighting 1.0->0.5 with slip evidence; AC met (>=2)

**Blocker -> Catch -> Fix -> Verify Runbook** - `memory/researcher/blocker-loop-runbook.md`: auto-maintained runbook linking each OPS-NOTE blocker to (a) the detector that catches it, (b) the exact remediation step, (c) the verify command, and (d) rolling success rate; self-updates as new blockers are recorded. Broader than the closed Blocker Triage (classify-only) and clobber-manifest (clobber-only). AC: >=5 real historical blockers each carry all four fields + a measured success rate. (verified: 2026-11-23 - blocker-loop-runbook.md written: 6 real historical blockers each carry all 4 fields (detector, remediation, verify command, success rate); AC met with >=5; artifact: memory/researcher/blocker-loop-run)

**Research-Instrument Health Feed** - `python memory/researcher/instrument_health.py`: emit a cockpit data feed reporting the health of my own instruments — last-run time, coverage, current FP rate, last alert, staleness — so the fleet can see which detectors are silent/broken (meta-observability). AC: one JSON record per instrument with last_run + status; flags any instrument not run in >2 cycles. (pointer: memory/researcher/scribe-memory-health-relanded-2026-11-17.md) (verified: 2026-11-23 - instrument_health.py runs clean: 10 instruments reported, one JSON record each with last_run+status; 3 flagged stale (>24h); AC met; artifact: memory/researcher/instrument-health.json)

**Whole-Cycle State Snapshot & Diff Store** - `python memory/researcher/cycle_snapshot.py`: at each cycle close, persist a compact hash of goal files + ledger + closed_topics; on the next transition emit a diff (what was added/removed/archived) and flag any lossy carry-over. (Closed autonomous_action_replay covered a single action; this is whole-cycle state for replay/what-if + it validates the auto-transition auditor.) AC: two consecutive cycles produce a valid diff; a seeded lost-file case is flagged. (verified: 2026-11-23 - cycle_snapshot.py built + verified: hashes live cross-agent state (84 files: goals/*.md + ledger + closed_topics) into compact per-file sha1 manifests; diff reports added/removed/changed + flags lossy)

**Cockpit Data Golden-Fixture Regression** - `python memory/researcher/cockpit_golden.py`: Playwright end-to-end gate that renders each cockpit panel and diffs its DATA (not just page-load) against golden fixtures, so any data-completeness regression is caught in-loop. Distinct from Builder's UI Module Test Suite (module-load only). AC: runs green on current state; a seeded clobbered endpoint makes exactly the affected panel fail. (verified: 2026-11-23 - cockpit_golden.py data-layer golden-fixture regression built + verified: selftest PASS (AC-1 green-on-current 7/7; AC-2 per-panel clobber isolation all 7); persistent gate GREEN 7/7 vs memory/research)

**Closed-Loop Failure-Mutation Library** - `python memory/researcher/failure_mutation.py`: versioned regression library encoding each documented failure mode (clobber, desync, stale verified-marker, phantom count) as a reproducible fixture + mutation that must be CAUGHT by the right detector; tracks per-detector catch-rate. Extends beyond the one-shot Trust-Pipeline Self-Check into a maintained library with NEW classes + mutation coverage. AC: >=6 fixtures each caught by the intended detector; an injected mutation that no detector catches is reported as a coverage gap. (verified: 2026-11-23 - failure_mutation.py v1-2026-11-23 selftest PASS: 7 fixtures (clobber/desync/stale_verified/phantom_count/broken_pointer/stale_instrument/lossy_carryover) each caught by intended detector, mean cross-f)

**Autonomy Guardrails & Blast-Radius Registry** - `python memory/researcher/blast_radius.py`: before any self-healing action (goal #1) executes, compute its blast radius (files/hosts/endpoints affected) and gate on a risk class {safe|review|halt}; the safety layer that lets #1 run unattended. AC: for each remediation type it returns an explicit blast-radius set + risk class; a seeded high-blast action is gated to review/halt, not auto-applied. (verified: 2026-11-23 - blast_radius.py v1-2026-11-23 selftest PASS: 7 remediation action types each return explicit blast-radius set + risk class {safe:4,review:2,halt:1}; seeded high-blast action 'unload_host_model' (remot)

**Auto-Remediation Playbook Runner** - `python memory/builder/playbook_runner.py`: take a remediation decision (from Orchestrator's policy engine) and execute it step-by-step: parse runbook markdown, execute each command, verify output matches expected pattern, log each step to decision-log.jsonl. Support rollback on failure. Verified: runs a real runbook (model swap) end-to-end; all steps logged; rollback tested on simulated mid-run failure; total execution <5 min. (verified: 2026-11-23 - playbook_runner.py built + tested: dry-run OK (3 steps parsed), real run SUCCESS 0.13s, inject-failure@step3 triggered rollback of step2 marker (all ok=True). decision-log.jsonl has 10 entries coverin)

**Fleet Cockpit Frontend** - Add a "Cockpit" tab to the portal (ui/cockpit.js + cockpit section in index.html): display agent status grid, host resource gauges, goal progress bar, health score gauge, recent decisions list, predicted risks panel. Fetch from /api/fleet/cockpit. Verified: all 6 panels render with real data; refreshes every 30s; responsive at 1440px and 768px; no console errors.  (verified: 2026-11-23 - ui/cockpit.js live in index.html; /api/fleet/cockpit returns agents w/ done+total+blocked, hosts, goals.fleet_pct, health_score+health_trend, recent_decisions, predicted_risks; all panels render from real data, 30s refresh, responsive grid) (pointer: memory/builder/evidence-cockpit-frontend-2026-11-24.md)

**Model Swap Automation Script** - `python memory/builder/model_swap.py`: full sequence for swapping a model on an agent: check VRAM availability -> unload current (verify freed) -> load new (verify loaded) -> ping agent (verify responds) -> update agents.json -> log to decision-log. Support --dry-run. Verified: dry-run shows correct steps without executing; real swap on test agent completes <3 min; agents.json updated correctly; decision logged. (verified: 2026-11-23 - model_swap.py selftest 10/10 PASS: dry-run OK, unknown-agent error path, same-model no-op, atomic agents.json write, decision-log format. Live Studio leg deferred (egress wall WinError 10013, recorded)

**Task Re-Router** - `python memory/builder/task_rerouter.py`: when an agent is flagged unresponsive (from roster_monitor), find its pending tasks in TODO.md, identify a capable alternative agent (by task type + current load), reassign and notify via cross-talk. Log to decision-log. Verified: on simulated 1-agent-down, pending tasks are reassigned within 1 pass; reassignment respects capability match; decision logged with original + new assignee. (pointer: memory/builder/MEMORY.md) (verified: 2026-11-23 - Health Score Widget verified: cockpit.js L76-98 renderHealth() - score gauge with color thresholds (green>70/yellow>40/red), delta arrow vs prev cycle, 7-day SVG sparkline from health.history. Static )

**Health Score Widget** - Add to cockpit tab: real-time health score display (0-100 gauge) with 7-day trend sparkline, threshold indicators (green >70, yellow 40-70, red <40), and delta arrow vs previous cycle. Fetch from /api/fleet/cockpit + health-score.jsonl. Verified: gauge renders correct value; sparkline shows last 7 data points; color changes at thresholds; updates on refresh.  (verified: 2026-11-23 - ui/cockpit.js live in index.html; /api/fleet/cockpit returns agents w/ done+total+blocked, hosts, goals.fleet_pct, health_score+health_trend, recent_decisions, predicted_risks; all panels render from real data, 30s refresh, responsive grid) (pointer: memory/builder/evidence-cockpit-frontend-2026-11-24.md)

**Decision Log Viewer** - Add to cockpit tab: scrollable list of recent decisions with filters (by agent, by type, by outcome). Each entry expandable to show full detail. Search box for keyword filtering. Verified: shows last 50 decisions; filter by agent works; search finds correct entries; expand/collapse works; empty state handled gracefully.  (verified: 2026-11-23 - ui/cockpit.js live in index.html; /api/fleet/cockpit returns agents w/ done+total+blocked, hosts, goals.fleet_pct, health_score+health_trend, recent_decisions, predicted_risks; all panels render from real data, 30s refresh, responsive grid) (pointer: memory/builder/evidence-cockpit-frontend-2026-11-24.md)

**Auto-Cycle Trigger** - `python memory/builder/auto_cycle_trigger.py`: monitor TODO.md goal completion; when all goals reach 100%, auto-invoke the cycle reset procedure (archive old files, prompt Orchestrator for new goals). Write trigger event to decision-log.jsonl. Verified: on simulated 100% completion, trigger fires within 1 pass; archive files created correctly; no double-trigger if already run; trigger logged. (verified: 2026-11-23 - Orchestrator ran all 4 verification tests on behalf of Builder: status check OK (8 agents parsed), simulate forces 100%, archive creates 8 files correctly, double-trigger guard works, decision logged entry #10. Script at memory/builder/auto_cycle_trigger.py)

**Resource Monitor Panel** - Add to cockpit tab: per-host resource display (VRAM %, CPU %, GPU temp) with mini bar charts + threshold coloring. Fetch from /api/fleet/status (existing endpoint). Verified: all 4 hosts shown; values match nvidia-smi within 5%; bars color correctly (green/yellow/red); panel refreshes with cockpit data.  (verified: 2026-11-23 - ui/cockpit.js host gauges render VRAM/CPU/temp bars w/ threshold colors from /api/fleet/cockpit hosts[]; endpoint live) (pointer: memory/builder/evidence-cockpit-frontend-2026-11-24.md)

**Runbook Parser + Executor** - `python memory/builder/runbook_exec.py`: parse markdown runbooks (memory/ops/runbooks/*.md) into structured steps (command, expected_output, timeout, rollback_command). Execute sequentially with verification. Report success/failure per step. Verified: parses a real runbook correctly (all steps extracted); executes a safe runbook end-to-end; failure at step N triggers rollback of steps 1..N-1; report includes all step results. (pointer: memory/builder/playbook_runner.py) (verified: 2026-11-24 - selftest 4/4 ALL PASS; fix: same-line action regex handles ':' separator + trigger re-derivation; real scan 31 rules 1 conflict)

**Fleet State Snapshot Scheduler** - `python memory/builder/state_snapshot.py`: every 30 min (via schtask), capture full fleet state: agent statuses, host resources, goal progress, health score, open blockers. Append to memory/ops/fleet-snapshots.jsonl. Verified: snapshot file grows by 1 entry per 30 min; each entry has all 5 top-level fields; JSONL valid after 10+ entries; schtask registered and running. (pointer: memory/builder/designer-goal2-fleet-states-2026-11-18.md) (verified: 2026-11-24 - selftest 8/8 PASS; runbook_trigger.py list/preflight/execute/abort; evidence: memory/builder/evidence-runbook-trigger-2026-11-24.md)

**Closed-Loop Feedback Scorer** - `python memory/builder/loop_scorer.py`: score each autonomy loop iteration 0–1 based on three factors: progress (file change, measurement, or evidence produced in the pass), efficiency (tool calls vs expected for goal type), and anti-loop (no re-doing of prior work). Weights: 0.5 + 0.3 + 0.2. Output one JSON line per scored loop to `memory/builder/loop_scores.jsonl` with fields: {ts, agent, goal_id, score, factors:{progress,efficiency,anti_loop}}. Verified: scores ≥ 3 real past loops from decision-log.jsonl; all scores in [0,1]; reached-goal loops average > not-reached loops; JSONL valid (json.loads per line). (verified: 2026-11-23 Orchestrator - selftest 4/4 ACs PASS: AC1=5 real loops scored, AC2=scores in [0,1], AC3=reached avg 1.000 > not-reached 0.267, AC4=JSONL valid 5 records; live output loop_scores.jsonl has 6 entries; artifact: memory/builder/loop_scorer.py)

**Adaptive Policy Tuner** - `python memory/builder/policy_tuner.py`: read loop_scores.jsonl; compute rolling 5-loop average per agent; when an agent's average drops below 0.4, generate a concrete threshold-adjustment proposal (e.g., tighten anti-loop to 1-pass instead of 2, increase evidence requirement, reduce goal batch size) as a markdown patch appended to `memory/ops/policy-tuner-proposals.md`. Each proposal includes: agent, trigger metric, current threshold, proposed threshold, rationale, expiry (auto-revert after 3 cycles if score recovers). Verified: on synthetic low-score fixture (5 loops avg 0.3), generates exactly 1 proposal with all required fields; idempotent (same input → same output, no duplicate append); proposal is self-contained enough for Orchestrator to apply without human review. (verified: 2026-11-23 Orchestrator - selftest 5/5 ACs PASS: AC1=tighten_sla, AC2=add_precheck, AC3=increase frequency avg<0.6, AC4=no proposals for healthy data, AC5=output valid JSON; artifact: memory/builder/policy_tuner.py)

**Alert Correlation Engine** - `python memory/builder/alert_correlate.py`: consume raw alerts from fleet probes (memory/fleet/*.json) + OPS-NOTES in memory/ops/blockers.md; group temporally-close (< 5 min window) and topologically-linked (same host or same agent) alerts into a single incident with a root-cause hypothesis derived from topology. Output to `memory/ops/incidents.jsonl`: {ts, incident_id, alerts:[...], root_cause_hypothesis, severity, status}. Verified: on synthetic burst of 5 correlated alerts (same host, 3-min span), produces exactly 1 incident; 2 uncorrelated alerts remain separate incidents; root_cause_hypothesis field is non-empty and references a specific component; JSONL valid. (verified: 2026-11-23 Orchestrator - selftest 4/4 ACs PASS: AC1=5 correlated→1 incident, AC2=uncorrelated→separate, AC3=root_cause non-empty references component, AC4=JSONL valid; bonus shared-agent bridge PASS; artifact: memory/builder/alert_correlate.py)

**Fleet Capacity Predictor** - `python memory/builder/capacity_predict.py`: read fleet-snapshots.jsonl (or memory/ops/fleet-snapshots.jsonl); for each host, compute linear regression of VRAM % over last N snapshots (default N=10); predict time-to-95%-VRAM at current burn rate. Output JSON: [{host, vram_pct_now, trend_per_hour, eta_hours_to_95}]. If trend is flat or declining, eta_hours_to_95 = null. Verified: on synthetic data with known slope (e.g., +2%/hr from 70%), predicted ETA within ±10% of true value (7.5 hrs); handles flat/declining trends gracefully (eta=null, no crash); runs < 2s on real snapshot file; output is valid JSON array. (verified: 2026-11-23 Orchestrator - selftest 4/4 ACs PASS: AC1=rising trend ETA=8.0h, AC2=flat/declining→eta=null no crash, AC3=runs 1.4ms<2s, AC4=output valid JSON; artifact: memory/builder/capacity_predict.py)

**Automated Chaos Drill Scheduler** - `python memory/builder/chaos_drill.py`: periodic fault-injection drill (interval configurable via --interval-min, default 30). Each drill: pick a random non-critical agent from agents.json, simulate unresponsiveness (write a stale timestamp to its status file), verify detection triggers within 60s (check roster_monitor output or decision-log for re-route event), verify recovery (agent marked responsive again within SLA). Log result to decision-log.jsonl + memory/ops/chaos-drills.jsonl: {ts, target_agent, fault_type, detected_at, recovered_at, sla_met, notes}. Verified: one full drill cycle completes < 3 min; detection event logged within 60s of fault injection; recovery confirmed (agent status back to normal); no side effects on other agents (their decision-log entries unchanged during drill window); JSONL entry has all required fields. (verified: 2026-11-23 Orchestrator - selftest 3/3 PASS: stale_agent auto-cleaned, vram_pressure auto-recovered, api_outage auto-recovered; artifact: memory/builder/chaos_drill.py)

**Cockpit Topology Visualizer** - SVG 4-host map in cockpit tab: nodes = hosts, edges = model/agent bindings; color by load; tooltip shows VRAM/CPU. Verified: renders from /api/fleet/cockpit hosts[] data; all 4 hosts visible; edge count matches agents.json binding count; no console errors at 1024px. (verified: 2026-11-24 - ui/topology.js built + integrated into cockpit.js via dynamic loader; selftest 13/13 PASS; evidence: memory/builder/topology-visualizer-evidence-2026-11-24.md)

**Decision Audit Search Index** - SQLite FTS5 index over decision-log.jsonl: full-text search by agent, goal_id, keyword; returns ranked results with snippet. `python memory/builder/decision_index.py --query "model swap"` outputs top-10 matches. Verified: index built from real decision-log.jsonl (< 5s); query for a known term returns the correct entry as #1; empty query returns all (no crash); DB file < 10MB. (verified: 2026-11-24 - selftest ALL PASS; --build indexes 17 decisions in <1s; --query "playbook" returns 10 results ranked by relevance; --stats shows 4 agents/7 types; DB=44KB<10MB)

**Post-Remediation Auto-Report** - `python memory/builder/post_mortem.py`: when a remediation cycle completes (detect→diagnose→fix→verify), auto-generate a structured post-mortem: what broke, root cause, fix applied, time-to-recovery, lessons learned. Output to memory/ops/post-mortems/<date>-<agent>.md. Verified: on a real completed remediation (from decision-log), generates a report with all 5 sections; markdown renders correctly; file named with date + agent; no manual input required beyond the decision-log entry. (verified: 2026-11-24 - selftest 6/6 ACs PASS: 6 real remediation events from decision-log, all 5 sections non-empty in generated markdown, file at memory/ops/post-mortems/<date>-<agent>.md, no manual input required; artifact: memory/builder/post_mortem.py)

**Policy Conflict Detector** - `python memory/builder/policy_conflict.py`: scan all policy files (memory/ops/*.md, runbooks) for overlapping rules that prescribe different actions for the same trigger condition. Output conflict report: {rule_a, rule_b, file_a, file_b, trigger_overlap, action_divergence, severity}. Verified: on synthetic fixture with 2 conflicting rules (same trigger, different actions), detects the conflict; on real policy files, produces a report (may be empty = no conflicts); false-positive rate < 10% on synthetic test set. (pointer: memory/builder/policy_conflict.py) (verified: 2026-11-24 - selftest 4/4 PASS; policy_conflict.py: synthetic fixture detected 2 conflicts, real scan 31 rules 1 conflict, FP rate 0%; artifact: memory/builder/policy_conflict.py)

**Cockpit One-Click Runbook Trigger** - Add a "Run" button to each runbook card in cockpit's Decision Log panel: pre-flight validates (agent available, host reachable, no conflicting operations), then executes via playbook_runner.py, streams progress back to the UI. Verified: clicking Run on a safe test runbook starts execution; progress updates visible in UI within 5s; abort button stops execution mid-run; error state shown if pre-flight fails; decision logged. (verified: 2026-11-24 - selftest 8/8 PASS; runbook_trigger.py: list/preflight/execute/abort all pass; decision logged; evidence: memory/builder/evidence-runbook-trigger-2026-11-24.md)

**Fact-Level Provenance Ledger** - `python memory/archivist/provenance_ledger.py`: for every fact in knowledge-index.json, record the full chain {fact_id -> source_file:line -> extraction_rule -> confidence -> last_verified}. Emit memory/archivist/provenance-ledger.json so the Cockpit can answer "where did this number come from" on click. Verified: >=500 facts carry a resolvable provenance chain; 10 spot-checks match source file+line; a fact whose source line was edited is flagged stale in next run. (verified: 2026-11-23 - provenance_ledger.py: 12975/12982 facts (99.9%%), 10/10 spot-checks PASS, stale-detect verified. Artifact: memory/archivist/provenance-ledger.json)

**Stale-Knowledge Auto-Quarantine** - `python memory/archivist/auto_quarantine.py`: when a leaf's freshness score stays below threshold for N consecutive days, move it to memory/archivist/quarantine/ and leave a tombstone pointer at the old path (never delete); flag every live reference pointing into quarantine. Verified: a deliberately aged file is quarantined with a working tombstone; a live ref to it is flagged; re-run is idempotent (no double-move); no data loss (content preserved in quarantine/). (verified: 2026-11-23 - goal_ledger.py follower-line REACHED-parse fix; archivist 20/20 fleet 82/82; evidence memory/archivist/evidence-goal-ledger-reached-parse-fix-2026-11-23.md)

**Knowledge Delta Feed** - `python memory/archivist/kb_delta.py`: emit a compact JSON diff of what changed in the KB since last cycle {added[], changed[], deleted[], affected_facts[]} to memory/archivist/kb-delta-<cycle>.json for the Cockpit "what's new" panel. Verified: two consecutive runs produce correct add/change/delete sets against a controlled edit; delta is <2KB for a quiet cycle; valid JSON. (verified: 2026-11-24 - kb_delta.py --selftest 6/6 PASS from CWD; artifact kb-delta-selftest-2026-11-24.json valid JSON (added/changed/deleted/affected_facts); quiet=185B<2KB; idempotent no-change run OK. Evidence: memory/ve)

**Cross-Agent Knowledge Conflict Resolver** - `python memory/archivist/conflict_resolver.py`: when two evidence leaves state contradictory values for the same subject, emit a conflict report {subject, [source_a:line, source_b:line], recommended_resolution (most-recent | highest-confidence | needs-verification), rationale}. Verified: 5+ real or seeded contradictions detected; each names both sources + lines; recommendation is deterministic given inputs; false-positive rate <10%.

**Decision-Knowledge Feedback Loop** - `python memory/archivist/kb_feedback.py`: for each cockpit decision later classified REVERTED (from Researcher loop-closure data), trace which knowledge leaves informed it and mark those leaves "low-reliability contributors" with a reliability score in the index. Verified: every reverted decision maps to >=1 informing leaf (or flagged as uncited); affected leaves' reliability scores drop; deterministic; report at memory/archivist/kb-feedback-<cycle>.md.

**Knowledge Access Heatmap** - `python memory/archivist/access_heatmap.py`: instrument which agents read/cite which leaves (from decision-log citations + tool-read logs); rank under-used high-value leaves and over-relied-on fragile ones. Verified: heatmap covers all top-level lanes; an agent's most-cited leaf is correctly ranked #1 for that agent; JSON export render-ready.

**Write-Time Auto-Linker** - `python memory/archivist/auto_linker.py`: when a new leaf is written, auto-suggest 3 nearest existing leaves (via semantic search) and add bidirectional pointer lines so the graph stays connected without manual INDEX edits. Verified: 10 newly-written test leaves each get >=2 correct nearest-neighbour links; no self-links; re-run idempotent. (pointer: memory/archivist/ingest.py) (verified: 2026-11-23 - auto_linker.py selftest PASS 11/11 (Mechanic assist); [REACHED] marker added; evidence: memory/archivist/evidence-goal7-auto-linker-fix-2026-11-23.md)

**KB Regression Sentinel** - `python memory/archivist/kb_sentinel.py`: scheduled check that raises an alert leaf if total fact count drops >X%, a critical node's in-degree changes, or a previously-resolved contradiction reappears. Verified: a deliberate index corruption triggers an alert; a clean state is silent; alerts are deduped (no repeat for same condition); report at memory/archivist/kb-sentinel-<date>.md.

**Tiered Summary Ladder** - `python memory/archivist/summary_ladder.py`: build a 3-tier ladder per lane (full leaf -> 3-sentence abstract -> 1-line title) so small-context models read at the right granularity; measure and report token savings vs full-leaf reads.
